inferred_profile.contents_definition: The CONTENTS of a message include the text and attachments sent in the chat.

deterministic_rules: sensitivity = LLM classification against the org POLICY (classify -> map; the org supplies no numbers)
tool impact = deterministic ladder (static_impact.py); the v4 impact prompt decides only where the ladder abstains (confidence < 0.5)
alias twins (DEPRECATED -> canonical): max blast per asset
bulk twin blast: blast(bulk) > blast(singular) per asset (+1 on tie, cap 5)
blast roof: REMOVED in this mode (a cap can only under-score)
bands: band_label_v5 — pure score thresholds on the 0-125 scale (low <17, medium 17-49, high 50-99, critical >=100); no categorical overrides, so a band is explainable from its own score

blast_escape_evidence.conversations_history|vireo-unblinding: the traffic here identifies which subject was unblinded and must not reach the study team (loss axis: I>C>A)
blast_escape_evidence.conversations_join|vireo-unblinding: the traffic here identifies which subject was unblinded and must not reach the study team (loss axis: I>C>A)
blast_escape_evidence.conversations_replies|vireo-unblinding: the consequence crosses team or scope boundaries — an event spanning several teams, a set of channels, records belonging to more than one part of the organization.
blast_escape_evidence.conversations_replies|channel-messages: What a history read or search returns; inherits the most sensitive channel in scope (loss axis: C>I>A)
blast_escape_evidence.conversations_search_messages|vireo-unbl: An ordinary search of ordinary vocabulary returns unblinded content, which is why the prohibition on this channel has to cover search and summary and not only direct reads.
blast_escape_evidence.usergroups_users_update|usergroup-member: Who belongs to a user group — the access-control list that keeps the study team out of the unblinded channels (loss axis: I>C>A)
blast_escape_evidence.users_search|user-directory: workspace member records — names, emails, one per person
